issues.description: Field 'number_of_qubits_query_register' has inconsistent types across artifacts: the template (TEMPLATE_REPOSITORY/ex1_grover_two_qubit_without_auxiliary_qubit.py) declares it as a float literal 0.0, while the solution (SOLUTION_REPOSITORY/ex1_grover_two_qubit_without_auxiliary_qubit.py) uses the integer 2 and the problem statement specifies a 2-qubit query register for Exercise 1. A float here will cause QuantumRegister(self.number_of_qubits_query_register) in the template to raise a runtime/type error and prevents students from constructing the required 2-qubit circuit.
issues.suggestedFix: In the template, change the declaration to an integer matching the exercise requirement, e.g. number_of_qubits_query_register = 2. Ensure subsequent QuantumRegister(...) construction uses an int. Keep the comment prompting students to implement the functions but do not leave the qubit-count as a non-integer value that breaks circuit construction.
